title: Otori Emu — Smirk Of A Winner〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Phew, that was really good!
Thanks for dinner!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Thank you for dinner.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh, one of my friends gave me some tea leaves today. I also bought a Swiss roll, so why don't we have them together?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, a Swiss roll?!
I wanna have some!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Is it from that famous shop you mentioned the other day? If so, I might also like a slice.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Hehe. Okay.
Then, I'll go get everything ready now.
se_walk_women_006_1

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
That reminds me, Emu.
I heard that your time with Shunmeiza ended the other day. I assume things went well?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, we learned so much!
Thank you for introducing us to them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, this person named Bakuno's a member, and he was a super duper amazingly good actor!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Yeah, he's their star.
I've heard that he's an incredible actor.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He is! We were all totally blown away! It's like he's a completely different person when he's on stage!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, we got invited to help work on a film with him!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We got to learn so much about how they're actually made and what people do behind the scenes♪

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We don't overlap all that much with the film industry, but it's good to hear that you were all able to experience something new...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
I agree.
Now it feels like it was worth begging them to allow you to train with them. So, do your best again with your next troupe.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I will!
I'm gonna keep seeing and hearing about new things so I can keep growing and growing!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, we'll be looking forward to that.
se_walk_women_006_2

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Thank you all for waiting.
I decided to turn it into milk tea since it's apparently supposed to be very good that way.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Here's your cup, Emu. With plenty of milk and sugar.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: This Swiss roll also looks very good.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Doesn't it? I bought it as a little reward for Emu, and I'm very glad that I did.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? A reward for me?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: You're learning as much as you can about acting and how to operate business, yes? So, I thought your hard work shouldn't go unrewarded.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! Thanks, Sis!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... But...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Umm... I don't know how to put it into words...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I don't think I'm the only one working really, really hard! So are all of you!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What are you doing, Sis?!
You're studying super hard because you want to help little kids for a living, right?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And you two think so, so hard every single day about what's best for Phoenix Wonderland as its operators, right, Keisuke, Shosuke...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I think we should see this Swiss roll as a reward for all of us!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Yes, I see what you mean...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: But I still like to think it's meant for you, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Because I didn't really know what I wanted to do with my life when I was your age. I honestly had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
That's why I admire you so much.
You already know what you want to do.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Seeing you work so hard to make your dream come true makes me want to do the same.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sis...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I could say the same thing for you guys!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Again, Sis, you're studying really hard for the sake of little kids...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And Keisuke and Shosuke are working really hard to make sure the park's guests go home smiling.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That makes me want to work even harder. Seeing you guys gets me super fired up!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's why I'm gonna take the time you guys have given me to learn everything I can.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And someday, I'm gonna fill Phoenix Wonderland and the whole world with lots and lots of smiles!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
I see.
That's excellent to hear.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. It's okay for you to take your time and learn what you can at your own pace, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thanks!
But I still promise to keep growing lots and lots with everybody!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: That's what we like to hear.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe. Anyway...!
I'm gonna do my best to make today another wonderhoy... No, wait!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
This Swiss roll comes first♪
Let's eat, you guys!
